title: A four-stride Allan contrast does not establish incremental cross-collection Parkinson gait prediction
abstract: A four-stride swing-fraction Allan contrast did not establish improved Parkinson/control prediction from gaitpdb to gaitndd (162 source,31 target): augmented-minus-baseline log loss 0.002895, joint-bootstrap95% [-0.011136,0.033107]. This is a repeatedly reused, exploratory external-collection negative result with unresolved participant overlap, not untouched independent-cohort confirmation.
